forum.title: ST Edge AI cloud developer
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @chanchal94,

For the N6 this is deactivated. One of the reasons is that it is more complicated to provide a project than other STM32 without specific Hardware acceleration.

We are also thinking that the Dev Cloud should primarily help to benchmark models.

You should take a look at STM32Cube AI Studio for that.

[STM32Cube AI Studio- The next-gen stand-alone tool for embedded AI - STMicroelectronics](https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/campaigns/edge-ai-toolchain-for-mcus-z14.html)

We are also working on tutorial to help you recreate the application template you get in STM32Cube AI Studio.

Keep an eye to the documentation that you can find inside the studio.

Have a good day,

Julian
